question: Who was our top customer by completed revenue in 2024, and what was that customer's completed revenue in 2025? Give the customer's ID and name.

sql_attempts.sql: SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2024-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-12-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-12-31' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025 FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name ORDER BY rev_2024 DESC LIMIT 1
